headline: Approved retail cannabis license for Winooski Organics by a 4-0 vote.
summary: The meeting reviewed a retail cannabis license application from Winooski Organics. City Manager Elaine Wang said staff have no concerns, and the mayor thanked the business for its support of Downtown Winooski.
decisions: Approved the retail cannabis license application for Winooski Organics, 4-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Discussion/Approval: Retail Cannabis License - Winooski Organics ... Motion to approve the application made by Councilor Turkos and seconded by Councilor Goodrich. Motion passed 4-0.
